Specification: This module defines an SVG-based animation and visualization layer for a Tower of Hanoi specification. It renders the current state of the Hanoi towers into graphical elements, including tower poles, disks, a title, a step counter, and a success banner when all disks have been moved to the final tower. The module does not define the transition system itself; instead, it depends on state and constants imported from the Hanoi module and provides derived view operators for TLC frame generation and interactive SVG debugging.
IfThenElse: IF maxDisk = 0 THEN <<>> ELSE IF value >= maxDisk THEN <<maxDisk>> \o FindDisks(value - maxDisk, maxDisk \div 2) ELSE FindDisks(value, maxDisk \div 2)

IF towers[N] = 2^D - 1 THEN Group(<<Rect(10, 10, 340, 30, ("fill" :> "#4caf50" @@ "stroke" :> "#2e7d32" @@ "rx" :> "5")), Text(180, 30, "SOLVED!", ("text-anchor" :> "middle" @@ "font-size" :> "18px" @@ "font-weight" :> "bold" @@ "fill" :> "white"))>>, <<>>) ELSE Group(<<>>, <<>>)
CaseExpr: CASE diskSize = 1 -> "#e57373" [] diskSize = 2 -> "#81c784" [] diskSize = 4 -> "#64b5f6" [] diskSize = 8 -> "#ffd54f" [] diskSize = 16 -> "#ba68c8" [] diskSize = 32 -> "#4db6ac" [] diskSize = 64 -> "#ff8a65" [] OTHER -> "#90a4ae"
FunctionApplication: Rect(x - width \div 2, y, width, DiskHeight - 2, ("fill" :> DiskColor(diskSize) @@ "stroke" :> "#333" @@ "stroke-width" :> "1" @@ "rx" :> "3"))
TupleConstructor:
<<
        \* Pole
        Rect(x - 3, TowerBaseY - TowerHeight, 6, TowerHeight,
             ("fill" :> "#795548" @@ "stroke" :> "#333")),
        \* Base
        Rect(x - 40, TowerBaseY, 80, 8,
             ("fill" :> "#5d4037" @@ "stroke" :> "#333" @@ "rx" :> "2")),
        \* Tower label
        Text(x, TowerBaseY + 25, "Tower " \o ToString(towerIdx),
             ("text-anchor" :> "middle" @@ 
              "font-size" :> "12px" @@
              "fill" :> "#666"))
    >>
